socket-dualmode-ipv6-ipv4.title: Understand dual-mode IPv6/IPv4 sockets
socket-dualmode-ipv6-ipv4.short: One IPv6 socket can accept mapped IPv4 traffic when dual mode is enabled
socket-dualmode-ipv6-ipv4.summary: A dual-mode IPv6 socket can handle both IPv6 endpoints and IPv4-mapped addresses, reducing the need for separate listeners in suitable deployments.
socket-dualmode-ipv6-ipv4.why: Assuming every IPv6 socket automatically covers IPv4 can produce environment-dependent connection failures.
socket-dualmode-ipv6-ipv4.tips: Choose the address family deliberately, verify DualMode behavior on the target platform, and test both IPv4 and IPv6 paths.

httpclient-stream-upload-backpressure.title: Stream large HTTP request bodies instead of buffering them all
httpclient-stream-upload-backpressure.short: Keep upload memory bounded by passing a Stream to HttpClient
httpclient-stream-upload-backpressure.summary: StreamContent lets HttpClient consume request data progressively rather than requiring the whole payload to be materialized as a byte array or string first.
httpclient-stream-upload-backpressure.why: Pre-buffering large uploads can multiply allocations and memory pressure under concurrency.
httpclient-stream-upload-backpressure.tips: Keep the source stream alive through SendAsync/PostAsync, propagate cancellation, and measure buffering behavior of surrounding handlers and servers.

xmlreader-dtd-external-entity-security.title: Configure XmlReader for untrusted XML
xmlreader-dtd-external-entity-security.short: Make DTD and external-resource policy explicit before parsing input
xmlreader-dtd-external-entity-security.summary: XmlReaderSettings controls DTD processing and external resolution, which are security-sensitive when XML comes from an untrusted source.
xmlreader-dtd-external-entity-security.why: Permissive external entity resolution can make parsing access unexpected resources or consume excessive work.
xmlreader-dtd-external-entity-security.tips: Prohibit DTDs when they are unnecessary, set the resolver policy explicitly, and apply input-size limits outside the parser as well.

tar-entry-path-traversal-extraction.title: Keep archive extraction paths inside the destination
tar-entry-path-traversal-extraction.short: Treat TAR entry names as untrusted filesystem paths
tar-entry-path-traversal-extraction.summary: Archive entries can contain path components that attempt to escape the intended extraction directory if extraction policy does not constrain them.
tar-entry-path-traversal-extraction.why: Blindly joining an entry name to a destination can overwrite files outside the extraction root.
tar-entry-path-traversal-extraction.tips: Prefer extraction APIs with traversal protection, reject unsafe entry types when appropriate, and verify normalized destinations remain under the chosen root.

options-validation-startup-boundary.title: Validate critical ASP.NET Core options at startup
options-validation-startup-boundary.short: Fail deployment early when required configuration is invalid
options-validation-startup-boundary.summary: The options system can bind configuration and run validators, while ValidateOnStart moves validation to application startup instead of first use.
options-validation-startup-boundary.why: Lazy discovery of malformed configuration can leave a service apparently healthy until a rarely used path first requests the options.
options-validation-startup-boundary.tips: Use startup validation for configuration required to serve correctly, while keeping dynamic configuration rules compatible with reload behavior.

activitycontext-manual-propagation.title: Propagate ActivityContext across manual message boundaries
activitycontext-manual-propagation.short: Carry trace identity when automatic HTTP instrumentation is not the transport
activitycontext-manual-propagation.summary: ActivityContext represents distributed tracing parent information that can be extracted from message metadata and supplied when starting consumer work.
activitycontext-manual-propagation.why: Dropping the parent context breaks one logical operation into unrelated traces and makes cross-service diagnosis harder.
activitycontext-manual-propagation.tips: Use standard propagation formats, validate incoming context, and keep transport metadata separate from application baggage.

gchandle-pinning-lifetime.title: Keep GCHandle pinning scopes short and explicit
gchandle-pinning-lifetime.short: Pin managed memory only while native code requires a stable address
gchandle-pinning-lifetime.summary: A pinned GCHandle prevents the garbage collector from relocating its target so native code can use a stable pointer during the pin lifetime.
gchandle-pinning-lifetime.why: Long-lived or widespread pinning restricts heap compaction and can increase fragmentation or complicate object lifetime.
gchandle-pinning-lifetime.tips: Pin only for the native call or operation that needs it, always Free the handle, and prefer APIs designed around spans or native buffers when they fit.

await-aggregateexception-unwrapping.title: Understand exception observation with await and Task.WhenAll
await-aggregateexception-unwrapping.short: Await presents task failures differently from blocking AggregateException APIs
await-aggregateexception-unwrapping.summary: Task.WhenAll records failures from its component tasks, while awaiting the combined task throws through normal await exception semantics rather than requiring AggregateException handling in the common case.
await-aggregateexception-unwrapping.why: Assuming one caught exception is the complete failure set can hide other failed component tasks during fan-out work.
await-aggregateexception-unwrapping.tips: When every failure matters, inspect the component tasks or the completed aggregate task after the await fails instead of relying only on the caught exception.

invaliddataexception-compressed-stream-c.title: Handle InvalidDataException from corrupt compressed input
invaliddataexception-compressed-stream-c.short: Compressed streams can fail while data is being consumed, not only when opened
invaliddataexception-compressed-stream-c.summary: Decompression APIs can report InvalidDataException when compressed bytes violate the expected format or integrity checks during reading.
invaliddataexception-compressed-stream-c.why: Treating construction of a decompression stream as full validation can let malformed input fail much later in a processing pipeline.
invaliddataexception-compressed-stream-c.tips: Keep decompression inside the validation boundary, limit expanded output for untrusted data, and clean up partial results on failure.

unity-await-playerloop-context.title: Verify the resume context before using Unity objects after await
unity-await-playerloop-context.short: Async continuations and Unity object access have thread-affinity constraints
unity-await-playerloop-context.summary: Code that awaits asynchronous work must know where its continuation resumes before accessing Unity APIs that require the main thread or player-loop context.
unity-await-playerloop-context.why: A helper that resumes on a worker thread can make otherwise ordinary UnityEngine access fail or behave unpredictably.
unity-await-playerloop-context.tips: Keep the thread/context transition explicit, marshal back before Unity object access when needed, and bind asynchronous work to scene or object lifetime.
